scripts.test: tsx --test workers/shared/test/*.test.ts workers/core/test/*.test.ts workers/quran/test/*.test.ts workers/ar-linguistics/test/*.test.ts workers/backend/test/*.test.ts workers/arabic/test/*.test.ts workers/worldview/test/*.test.ts workers/studio/test/*.test.ts workers/content/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck:workers: for w in core ar-linguistics studio content worldview quran arabic backend; do npx tsc --noEmit -p workers/$w/tsconfig.json || exit 1; done
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build -w apps/k-maps && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/k-maps/dist/k-maps/browser --project-name k-maps --branch main
